description: The observed page-content record for one Amazon ASIN: description (with its source — prose vs 'About this item' bullets vs brand A+ content), feature bullets, breadcrumb category path, image-gallery URLs, variation count + parent ASIN, stock state, and first/last-observed timestamps. Set include_reviews=true to append the featured customer reviews shown on the page (rating, title, trimmed text, verbatim date, verified flag, helpful votes; reviewer names are not stored, so author is always null). Use when the user asks what a product's page says or shows — its description, bullets, images, categories, variations — or wants the reviews on a listing. Amazon marketplaces only.

include_reviews.description: Append the stored featured reviews (max 12). Default false — reviews are opt-in to keep the payload small.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR. Amazon only.

name: product_page_content
